Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:
Hi folks,

I was wondering if anyone knows about any Jyhad Tournaments at this
years UK Gen - Con (30th Aug - 2 Sept, Olympia 2).

I have just received a mailing about it, and I am keen to go, and would
love to play some Jyhad (I will have at least a couple of decks with me
anyway). Unfortunately, nothing was mentioned in the literature, or on
the web-site.

If anyone knows anything, please let me know, as I would feel it a waste
to go for more than 1 - 2 days if I only get to play Vampire: The
Masquerade
and a little (dare I say it) Magic.

We all know that Jyhad os better than Magic, surely we can't let the
only
game played there be that.

Andy

Andy, old chap, and anyone else coming to the UK Gencon, I can assure
you that we are going to have a veritable feast of VTES related fun at
this years event. The big event is the VTES UK National Cup event,
which will be going on from 10am until about 7pm in the Esdevium hall.
Registration will be from about 9am.

This is the biggest event in the UK VEKN calender, where all the
luminaries come out to try and pound each other into a messy pulp. We
have guranteed space for at least 32 people this year, so it should be
good (last year 30 people attended, this year we are looking for more,
clearly!).

Regitration details are just being sorted out as we speak, so it will
all become clear in a few days... just hang in there!

We are also working on a few other events over the weekend. These have
yet to be fully confirmed, but read thus:

Thursday - VTES Sealed Deck / Draft
Friday - Clan War

and not to mention that over the weekend, it is traditional that the
best players meet up in between events to play some very curious games
(going on until the wee hours). Last year, we were up all night...

It will be a good 'un. But full details will be coming very soon.

DH

Messages.Author: Mike Nudd
Messages.Body:
> > I was wondering if anyone knows about any Jyhad Tournaments at this
> > years UK Gen - Con (30th Aug - 2 Sept, Olympia 2).
>

> There's the "National Cup" tournament on September 1st - it's up on the
> V:TES Sanctioned Tournament calendar: http://calendar.yahoo.com/vtesrep/

Us VEKN types are currently working on this one, but we haven't made
many public postings as we're waiting for confirmation of many of the
details.

There is *definitely* going to be a national constructed event on Sat
1st Sept which will be held in the Esdevium playing area (a huge
thanks to Esdevium for the help there).

It is also *likely* that there will be additional events over the rest
of the con from Thur to Sun, but we are still waiting final
confirmation and approval of our plans.

WotC UK have just finished a move of premises from Maidenhead to
Heathrow, and before that most of their staff were organising big
Magic events in the UK and overseas. Hence most of the organisation of
the con is late in happening anyway...

Dave Hammond (dave...@hotmail.com) is the primary contact and
organiser for the VEKN events at GenCon UK if you need to contact
anyone. I'll add your name and e-mail address to the list of
'interested parties' we have on file for the convention.

Regards,

Mike Nudd
VEKN Prince of London
